_comment: Project facts every brief needs. Fill once (Orient), keep next to the roadmap. Unknown values stay TODO: never guess them.
HOUSE_RULES_SUMMARY: audit entry in the SAME transaction as the change; e-signatures with meaning and record version; optimistic concurrency (WHERE id AND version); strict input schemas with server-controlled fields stripped; actor always from the session; no silent failures.
DB_CREATE: PGPASSWORD=app psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U app postgres -c "create database <your db>"
MUST_KEEP_WORKING: the desktop shell tests (xvfb-run -a node tests/desktop-shell.cjs) after any change to the build, migrations or start-up
CHECKS: a) lint and type check (no new baseline errors)  b) the full test suite  c) build and bundle budget  d) install the schema the way a real install does, seed, start the built server, run the shared evidence checks against it  e) migration suite  f) desktop tests  g) traceability gate  h) repository-root hygiene
SHARED_COUNTERS: e.g. the number of signature meanings asserted by the upgrade test
DERIVED_FILES: e.g. schema export, permission matrix, route table
TRAILERS: <the commit trailer lines the session requires>
